tagline: Drop in a CSV, drag fields, get a pivot table.
description:
Choose a CSV or paste comma-separated text. Put fields on rows and columns — drag them on a computer, tap a role on a phone. Count, sum, or list unique values. Close the app and come back: the last table and the last arrangement come back with it. Your data stays on your device.

An unofficial port of PivotTable.js by Nicolas Kruchten. Same drag-and-drop grid. Charts that need extra libraries are not in this app.
